audit.notes: This template works with almost any collection of authentic lifestyle b-roll (cafes, walking in NYC, climbing gym, parks, subway). Simply use an initial calm/reflective clip for the hook, followed by 7-8 short dynamic clips representing small moments of effort, presence, or daily life.
audit.summary: A fast-cut compilation of travel and lifestyle b-roll clips paired with uplifting affirmations that counter self-doubt and feeling stuck.
